name: radio-guessr
description: A live, synchronized 'guess the song' game — same clip plays for everyone at once.

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.preview: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build && PORT=8787 npm --prefix server run start
